steps.content: Temporary background and other resources
[Transition] [Looping moving background, or looping blur effect, to make the background move slightly] [Rich sound effects]
You cannot move.
Everything before you feels both real and unreal. Whether it was the intense fight just now or the current eerie  calm, it all feels like a dream.
It feels like an invisible sheet of glass is pressing you flat. You can’t move your hands or feet, and you're forced to stare into the blinding white light.
[Transition] The screen blurs upon being tapped, making it feel uncomfortable.
You still cannot make any movements.
No one responds. In the distance, you hear bizarre sounds that resemble human voices, but are not quite human. You cannot understand their language.

steps.speaker: Distant Voice
steps.content: Avocados on sale! Avocados on sale! Half off only for now! Don't miss out on this great deal! Avocados on sale!
[Information overload] Slight distortion. Everything is shaking and changing. Your eyes are dazzled in an uncomfortable way.
The sounds overwhelm your ears, making you feel suffocated as if you are in a Black Ring. You remember the only weapon at your disposal...
[Screen shakes violently and goes to black]

The shaking vision finally stabilizes. The lights and shadows no longer flicker, and the ringing in your ears fade away. The world before you looks slightly different, but everything else returns to normal.
Even the culprit returns to her rightful place, smiling at you.
Feeling better? The gods' world is of higher dimensions. The information overload is too much for your paper-thin body to handle.
So, I put you into this little phone and adjusted it to a lower dimension mode. This way, you'll feel much better.
She giggles, and the view wobbles slightly... she probably just took a spin.
How do you like my new look? There's still room for improvement, though. Any suggestions?
How about my voice? Do you like it? Should I sing a song for you?
She looks extremely cheerful, like a bird out of a cage, which makes you feel that what she said to you on that rooftop was all an act.
There are no familiar figures around. Dimension change or not, this place is definitely not DisCity. Although the noise has been suppressed, you can still vaguely hear some sounds.
This place is not an illusion, nor a Black Ring, but another world beyond your comprehension.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you mean by "the gods' world"? Where exactly are we? How did you get me here? What do you want?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's happening in DisCity? Where are my companions?
Homesick already?
Look, the entrance to the game is now in your phone. You can check it anytime if you miss home.
[A glitchy performance] [The screen is murky, emitting wailing sounds]

steps.speaker: Blurry Voices
steps.content: Help... tsss... Chief... tsss... error... Somebody please help me! tsss... Chief, where are you? ...expanding... tsss... Is this the dark web or... tsss...
Unprecedented chaotic information floods the crevice you're in, making you instantly sober. You feel unprecedented panic, wanting to rush into the chaos to return to everyone.
But you are forcibly pulled back.
Alright, alright. There's a glitch over there, so we can't go back right now.
Once we finish our business, the problem will be solved.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What happened over there? What did you do?

steps.content: Haha, what could I have done? Didn't I tell you? Only the gods can change the world.
You feel absurd asking her this. But the crazed glimmer in her eyes makes it impossible for you to dismiss all this as a joke.
Yeah. You were unconscious for too long after coming here. Before you woke up, I went to meet some of the gods.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What did you make them do?

steps.content: Make them do? Hahaha, I wasn't there to pray to them.
I killed them all.
She extends her hand, and two strings of strange symbols float in her palm.
Look, this is the power of the gods. I might have accidentally messed up the game while transferring it. Sorry about that. Would you forgive me, please?
There are only two right now. Once we collect them all, everything will return to normal.
Actually no. By then we will dominate the entire game, and you will become the god of the new world.
Alright then, let's go!
She turns to leave with the phone. You feel a sudden weightlessness. The acceleration makes you nauseous and even more nervous.
Ugh, what now, Your Majesty?
What the...?!
Another violent shock hits you, and your vision blurs. It feels as if your body has shattered into countless tiny cubes, pulled out of a small cell phone and hurled into a bizarre tunnel.
Countless specks of light and numbers wash over you, then...
<color=#dg1f1f><size=44>- Message from 5732 -</color></size>

steps.speaker: Interference Noise
steps.content: Chief? Chief ${PlayerName}??

steps.speaker: Interference Noise
steps.content: The comms must have connected. If you hear this, please respond. Lots of people are looking for you.
This voice belongs to...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: It's me. Thank goodness you're alive.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: It's been 16 hours since you were swallowed by that rift. Even the Sinners' shackles can't sense your presence. What is going on...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief... come back now! Everything's messed up back home...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: There are so many monsters in the Bureau! I see doubles of everything, and I can't even aim my arrows... I even saw a freaking Godzilla in the sky!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you okay? Are you hurt? Where are you? Are you in danger?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You were swallowed by that rift. If we pass through it, can we reach you to help?
The familiar voices warm your heart, but you have to resist the urge to ask for help. Right now, you need to stay calm for their sake.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stay calm. That rift is unnatural. We don't know what might happen if you come over here. I'm relatively safe for now. Don't act on impulse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: By the way, how did you manage to contact me? Can you brief me on the situation?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The one who contacted you is...
(Sound of footsteps, someone falling down)

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Ah! Hot, hot, hot...

steps.speaker: Who's calling this late?
steps.content: Ugh... my coffee, and my report...
It sounds like someone fell, followed by a flurry of confused voices from the other side.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Huh? Chief, are you there? Oh right, you can't see the situation here. Should I put you on video call? Hmm... okay, it's done. Let's do a video call, Chief.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Oh no, I look too...
Another flurry of chaos ensues. A new stream of data converges beside you, forming a screen. With a flash of white light...
[Falling CG. Skip the blurry description and move on quickly]
The video connects, but what you see catches you off guard.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Ahaha... Hello Chief, sorry about that. I've been staying up for my tracking mission and got a bit dazed.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I'm Moore, Rise's colleague. I'm a technician at the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center. I handle most of the network security work and have recently been dealing with DisCity's dark web.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: By the way, I also worked on the Elysiland incident. Do you remember?

Moore is the head of the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center. She provided key support to the MBCC during the Gray Mirror and Elysiland incidents, but you haven't talked to her in person before. You only recently checked out her profile.
You vaguely remember that an expert helped crack the security system on Elysiland, installing a backdoor for your free access.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Haha, I'm glad I could help. We've worked well together before. I look forward to working with you again this time.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: When you get back, let's have a coffee? I've heard a lot about you, and have always wanted to meet you.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Let's save the chit-chat for later. Miss Moore, now that we've found who we were looking for, can you bring Chief back?

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: The situation out there is terrible. We really need him.
steps.female_content: The situation out there is terrible. We really need her.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Oh, sorry. I've been up all night, so I'm a bit over-excited.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It would be a challenge to bring you back right now. I need time to decode the barriers between the two worlds.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But right now I'm more concerned about what that Sinner meant by "killing the gods." Can you take me to the scene?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You tripped and fell, yet still managed to make a video call between two dimensions in seconds. I’m sure you can pull this off.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Haha, no problem. I've made preparations already. I knew you would make such a request.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: We all had a hunch that to solve DisCity's problems, you would need to pull a few strings over there.
The woman on the other end of the call smiles gently. She will become your beacon to explore the new world.
